name: Qwen3.5-0.8B
context_scaling: Native 262,144 in config.json (max_position_embeddings). The card does not publish a separate context-extension recipe for the 0.8B.
attention_variant: hybrid: Gated DeltaNet linear attention with full gated attention every 4th layer (6 of 24)
notes: ADDED 2026-11-08 from the trending feed, as the missing BASE for a derivative with unusually strong published evidence (models/qwen3-5-0-8b-weight-space-programming). No prior catalog record existed for Qwen3.5-0.8B even though models/xiaomi-ocr-0 cites Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base as its base, so the 0.8B rung of the Qwen3.5 ladder was unrepresented while 4B and above were covered. ARCHITECTURE read from config.json (text_config): Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, model_type qwen3_5_text, 24 layers, hidden 1024, 8 query / 2 KV heads, head_dim 256, 262144 native context, vocab 248320, tied embeddings. PARAMS: HF safetensors total 873,438,784 = 0.873B. Dense - the config carries no expert keys - so active_params_b equals params_b and flops_per_token_active = 2 x 0.873e9 = 1.747e9 on the schema's one-pass basis. KV: 6 full-attention layers x 2 (K and V) x 2 KV heads x 256 head_dim x 2 B = 12,288 B/token. The 18 linear-attention layers hold a constant Gated DeltaNet state that does not grow per token, so they are excluded; this is why a 0.8B model's KV figure (12 KiB/token) is smaller than the 4B's (32 KiB/token) rather than merely proportional. HARDWARE GATE: passes trivially - 0.873B active (<= 40) and 0.873 x 0.5 = 0.44 GiB at the catalog's 4-bit planning figure (<= 128). WHAT THIS RECORD IS FOR: it is the baseline the weight-space-programming derivative is measured against. The derivative's card prints base MODEL-500 7.9 / GSM8K 13.8 / IFEval 21.0 for the 0.8B, which is the only public evidence here on how badly the base loops on math - 93.0% of its base-model answers hit the token limit in the derivative's protocol. Benchmarks below are the card's own table for this exact checkpoint (vendor claims). NOTE the pre-trained base (Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base) and this post-trained model are different repos; the config here is the post-trained one.
